kind: Measured before-state and owned-fix evidence, not completion claim

methods.sample_design: Purposive five-head public CI sample spanning four owner epics plus a recently merged flow PR; not a random sample or whole-project percentile estimate.
methods.feedback_definition: Time from earliest workflow created_at for the exact sampled head to completion of the first job with substantive source/protocol/kernel/browser/unit assertions. Excludes classification-only jobs, summary-only jobs, skipped/cancelled jobs, and the Browser gate echo. Does not claim push-to-feedback latency or E2E completion.
methods.queue_definition: Per-job started_at minus created_at; dependency time before job creation is separate and not runner queue. Initial workflow queue is first executed job start minus attempt created_at. Parallel job queues are never summed and labelled wall time.
methods.execution_definition: Completed job completed_at minus started_at. Runner-seconds are a sum of executed jobs; workflow wall is last job completion minus attempt created_at. Step durations are contained in job duration, not added again.
methods.ready_definition: Last ready_for_review event before merge, or a lower bound until observed_at for still-open PRs. PR updated_at, created_at, commit timestamps, or inferred draft transitions are not substituted if event is absent. Three merged PRs were inspected across the three repos: two have explicit Ready events; Cloud #413 has none. Two still-open Ready PRs and two never-Ready Draft PRs are separately right-censored.
unknowns: All-attempt API authorization complete only for selected samples, not historical fleet-wide.
PR push receipt time not supplied; Git commit date is recorded separately, never presented as push latency.
No staging or production pass can be inferred from CI or skipped consumer workflow.
Private repository local artifacts and public workflow executions have different inputs; no cross-source reuse presumed.
methods.tested_source_definition: Actions run.head_sha binds the PR head. Default PR checkout tests GitHub's synthetic merge commit; both Source checks and first substantive feedback checkout SHAs were read from git log -1 --format=%H in the original job logs for every sampled head (10 jobs). A later current merge_commit_sha is not substituted for a historical candidate.
